## Core Capabilities
- [SEO Audit Tool](/): In-depth, 70-check technical website audit analyzing on-page SEO, speed, usability, security, links, social sharing, and AI search readiness.
- [Crawler & Site Audits](/crawls): Multi-page crawler discovering broken links, missing meta tags, and site-wide issues.
- [Website Monitoring](/monitors): Continuous uptime and SEO monitoring with alerts for score drops, SSL expiration, and outages.
- [Share Previews](/preview): Visual testing for social cards (Open Graph, Twitter/X cards, search snippets).
- [Comparison Tool](/compare): Side-by-side SEO comparison between two pages or against competitors.

## Agency Services
- Search Engine Optimization (SEO): Technical SEO, local search optimization, content strategy, and AI answer engine readiness (AEO / GEO).
- Website & Application Development: Fast, mobile-first websites optimized for Core Web Vitals and conversions.
- AI Automation & Workflows: Custom automated workflows to scale lead generation, customer outreach, and operations.
- Performance Marketing: ROI-focused ad campaigns across Google, Meta, and major platforms.
